answer: At epoch start, each identity locks an ivory seal — a hash of a secret only it knows — into the jetty registry. At settlement it must reveal the secret, and a raven check compares the reveals: two identities whose secrets derive from one operator key are voided at once. Each fake loses its full reward of about 258,000 POA and pays a 150,000 POA penalty from its bond to the peer that reported the match, so one fake costs about 408,000 POA and five fakes cost about 2,040,000 POA.
